newsitem.title: UK: UK shares edge higher, gilts lend support.
newsitem.headline: UK shares edge higher, gilts lend support.

text.p: UK shares were marked cautiously higher at the start of trading Friday, continuing Thursday's late rally sparked by renewed bid speculation and as renewed hopes for lower interest rates buoyed continental bourses.
The FTSE 100 was up 7.6 points at 4,057.8 by 0840 GMT, with gains in retailers Argos and Kingfisher helping drive the market higher. Gainers outweighed decliners by some three-to-one.
Traders said activity was likely to be muted in the absense of a fresh lead from Wall Street, closed yesterday for the Thanksgiving day holiday.
